slides.title: Start, or come in early
slides.body: Opening or adding a point in the first 2 minutes gets you noticed.

slides.title: Use "building on that..."
slides.body: Connect to others' points. It shows listening and leadership.

slides.title: Bring one fact or example
slides.body: A real example beats 5 generic opinions.

slides.title: Summarise at the end
slides.body: If nobody concludes, offer a 20-second summary. Evaluators love it.
